title: Polish Sausage Skillet Delight
description: A flavorful and hearty one-pan dish perfect for a chilly evening. Savor the taste of Poland with this simple and satisfying skillet recipe.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add the sliced bell pepper, onion, and garlic. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and stir to combine with the potatoes and vegetables.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
